title: Midnight Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy stir fry made with midnight oil and a variety of colorful ingredients. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Fry spices
ingredients.notes: use a blend of Chinese 5-spice powder and cumin

ingredients.name: Stir-fry vegetables
ingredients.notes: choose your favorite stir-fry vegetables, such as broccoli, carrots, and bell peppers

instructions: Heat the midnight oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the citrus and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the stir-fry vegetables and fry spices, and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes, until the vegetables are tender-crisp.
Stir in the gooey honey and Syrian sumac, and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, and serve hot.
